Package neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi

Class DexpiConnectionComponentInfo

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi.DexpiConnectionComponentInfo
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class DexpiConnectionComponentInfo extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable evidence for one weakly connected group of explicit DEXPI material-connection endpoint references.

A component groups source reference identities only. It does not establish hydraulic continuity, physical branch or fitting identity, process intent, or live ProcessSystem topology.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim

  • Constructor Details

    • DexpiConnectionComponentInfo

      public DexpiConnectionComponentInfo(String id, List<String> endpointIds, List<String> connectionIds, List<String> sourceEndpointIds, List<String> sinkEndpointIds, List<String> potentialMultiConnectionEndpointIds, List<String> unresolvedEndpointIds)
      Creates immutable source-reference component evidence.

      This legacy constructor preserves scalar and identity evidence only. hasCompleteEvidence() returns false; use the complete-evidence constructor when endpoint and connection records are available.

      Parameters:
      id - deterministic component evidence identity
      endpointIds - explicit endpoint identities in first-reference order
      connectionIds - connection-evidence identities in source order
      sourceEndpointIds - endpoints classified as source evidence
      sinkEndpointIds - endpoints classified as sink evidence
      potentialMultiConnectionEndpointIds - endpoints with multiple incoming or outgoing occurrences
      unresolvedEndpointIds - endpoint identities that do not resolve in the source document

    • DexpiConnectionComponentInfo

      public DexpiConnectionComponentInfo(String id, List<String> endpointIds, List<DexpiConnectionEndpointInfo> endpoints, List<String> connectionIds, List<DexpiConnectionInfo> connections, List<String> sourceEndpointIds, List<String> sinkEndpointIds, List<String> potentialMultiConnectionEndpointIds, List<String> unresolvedEndpointIds)
      Creates immutable source-reference component evidence with complete endpoint and connection occurrences.
      Parameters:
      id - deterministic component evidence identity
      endpointIds - explicit endpoint identities in first-reference order
      endpoints - endpoint evidence records in first-reference order
      connectionIds - connection-evidence identities in source order
      connections - connection occurrences in source order
      sourceEndpointIds - endpoints classified as source evidence
      sinkEndpointIds - endpoints classified as sink evidence
      potentialMultiConnectionEndpointIds - endpoints with multiple incoming or outgoing occurrences
      unresolvedEndpointIds - endpoint identities that do not resolve in the source document
